description: Ostreid herpesvirus 1, complete genome (NCBI RefSeq), 207,439 bp
used_for: Per-sample viral read QC in workflows/rnaseq (--viral_reference): counting read pairs that map to the virus in pathogen-challenge RNA-seq.
caveats: This is the reference OsHV-1 genome, not the microvariant (uVar) strains used in current challenge studies. Divergence lowers the counts in infected animals; it cannot place reads into an uninfected one. Treat counts as QC, not as a titre.
